title: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow stops running with no error after 60 days in a public repo
symptoms: Cron workflow has no runs for weeks
The workflow page shows it as disabled
Schedule edits on a feature branch never run
cause: In public repositories, scheduled workflows are disabled automatically after 60 days without repository activity. Schedules also only run from the default branch.
fix: Re-enable the workflow and keep some activity in the repo, or trigger it from an outside scheduler with workflow_dispatch. Merge schedule changes to the default branch.
apply:
gh workflow enable nightly.yml
gh workflow run nightly.yml
affected: GitHub Actions schedule trigger in public repositories, as of October 2026
